note: One run from the printed procedure: power on with the pointer knob at 0 (the dial's construction state is D0, so no dialGrab is needed), steps 1-6 for a train moving left to right, then pushbutton 5 alone. Wires are the printed 25 unchanged, image-read by the author against the repo render of PDF p.15 and matching programs.json; ER-29 is prose only (the p.10 second sentence should read 'The same will be true for a train moving right through. . . .'), so errata_applied is empty. Not asserted: the knob at 0 after power-on; 'set the pointer knob of the rotary switch at 0' is the printed setup instruction, met here by the dial's construction state, not a printed observation. Asserted: the until on dial 7 after step 1 (window 10 s, sized for a run rate as slow as 25 rpm), and dial 7 again 5 s after each of steps 1-5, so the asserts check where the knob rests, not a pass-through. Hold lengths (5 s per step, 10 s after step 6, 5 s for pushbutton 5 alone) are script choices. Not asserted, left to Step 7 as derived: the dial's return to 0 after step 6 (the page says only that the gate remains closed until none of the switches is activated; programs.json printedUnprinted); 'Notice that the gate does not close' for pushbutton 5 alone, since expect asserts equality only and dial 0 there would rest on the derived return; the ER-29 corrected sentence ('The same will be true for a train moving right through. . . .') and the train that 'enters the crossing, stops and backs out again', for which no button sequence is printed. No lamp state is printed. In the trace the dial runs 0 to 7 on step 1, holds 7 through step 5, runs back to 0 on step 6, and does not move while pushbutton 5 is held alone. Motor sweep (motor-sensitivity.md): V-EXP7/first-switch-closes-gate is FRAGILE on coast_udeg_stop_shorted (passes 0-16.875 deg); the profile value 5 deg passes and is not tuned. No knife-edge trip (minDecisionUa 92, minTickGap 9). Rotary run rate, coast and geometry remain profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5.
